title: Description and Part Number must be filled before a new part saves
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a part number for a new part, part A, that no part or Part Library entry uses yet.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Save.
  3. Type three spaces in the Description field.
  4. Type three spaces in the Part Number field.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Replace the spaces in the Description field with a description for part A.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Replace the spaces in the Part Number field with part A's part number.
  9. Pick any category in the Category field.
  10. Type 10.00 in the Cost field.
  11. Click Save.
  12. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description is outlined in red with "Description is a required field" under it.
  • Part Number is outlined in red with "Part number is a required field" under it, at the same time.
  • The window stays open and nothing is saved (Category and Cost may show their own required messages, as they do today).

Step 3:

  • Description holds the three spaces.

Step 4:

  • Part Number holds the three spaces.

Step 5:

  • Both messages still show: a field that holds only spaces counts as empty.
  • Nothing is saved.

Step 6:

  • Description holds part A's description.

Step 7:

  • The Description message has gone.
  • "Part number is a required field" still shows under Part Number, and nothing is saved.

Step 8:

  • Part Number holds part A's part number and its message has gone.

Step 9:

  • The category shows in the Category field.

Step 10:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 11:

  • The window closes and the part is saved.

Step 12:

  • One row is listed for part A, with its description.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-N1: “Description is required. Left empty, or holding only spaces, the field shows "Description is a required field" and the part is not saved.”
  • S7-N2: “Part Number is required. Left empty, or holding only spaces, the field shows "Part number is a required field" and the part is not saved.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Description field empty or only spaces | "Description is a required field" | Inline error on the field, stays until corrected”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Part Number field empty or only spaces | "Part number is a required field" | Inline error on the field, stays until corrected”
  • Key Decisions: “Part Number is required, on create and on edit. The Part Library link, the duplicate check and the other-locations warning all depend on the number. A shop without its paperwork yet types a temporary number and corrects it later, which keeps the part, its history and its Part Library entry (Story 13).”
